summary: Snyder County, PA steel M-M tower built 1949 per the register, now not standing; TopoQuest maps a Beavertown Fire Tower at the same coordinates. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says it is no longer standing; no removal date is given

events.note: Register says a steel M-M tower was built in 1949
Registered September 16, 2008 as FFLOS US 192, PA 21; nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: site is in Snyder County, Pennsylvania
elevation 2,098 ft (639 m) per the register
steel M-M tower built in 1949 and no longer standing
evidence.quote: This steel M-M tower was built in 1949 and is no longer standing.

evidence.supports: register coordinates N 40.722582, W 077.122207 match the TopoQuest tower feature
TopoQuest lists a Beavertown Fire Tower in Snyder County at 2096 ft
evidence.quote: Beavertown Fire Tower is a tower located in Snyder County, PA at N40.722582° W77.122207° (WGS84/NAD83) and at an elevation of 2096 ft MSL.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 2,098 ft (639 m); TopoQuest gives 2,096 ft. Story reports both figures and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one register entry and one map-feature page. No removal date, reason, or staffing found. A statewide PA lookout inventory (firelookout.org, last updated 2008) appears in search results as listing a 'Beaver' steel 1949 tower in Snyder County as not standing, but that page would not fetch and is not cited; link to this site is unconfirmed. Brief's coordinates match both sources exactly. Brief's elevation_m 639.5 is consistent with the register's 639 m.
